description_en: A cozy restaurant-lounge with a panoramic view of the Carpathians.

Veranda restaurant is located in a picturesque area of Bukovel. It is an ideal place to relax after an active day in the mountains. Light European cuisine, a wide selection of seafood dishes, signature cocktails, and an exclusive hookah menu create an atmosphere of perfect harmony and premium-class relaxation.
